name: Mourning Veil of Cold Vengeance
text:
These delicate white veils cover the face and spill out into long cloaks. Mourning veils are worn by mourners who hope to wield their grief as a weapon, using it to aid their allies and avenge their deaths.

Activate—Shed Tears r

Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally within 15 feet of you gains the dying condition

---
Effect You mourn your ally's fall. Your tears freeze into ice, chilling those around you. While your ally that triggered Shed Tears has the dying condition, any creature that starts its turn adjacent to you takes 2d6 cold damage with a DC 27 basic Fortitude save save. If the creature critically fails, it's also Slowed 1 for 1 round.
